title: Tensor action through the single complex unit
statement: Let Y be a scheme and F,V,P be arbitrary integer-indexed complexes of its module sheaves, with total tensor [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] and the recorded sheaf tensor [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Put O equal to the single complex on the module tensor unit. For a chain map e:Tot(V tensor P) to O, define the tensor action Tot(Tot(F tensor V) tensor P) to F as the complex associator, then Tot(id_F tensor e), then the complex right unitor. This is a composite of the standard constructed complex maps.
